## Purpose

## Evidence level

- [ ] Implemented
- [ ] Experimentally verified
- [ ] Prototype
- [ ] Simulation
- [ ] Proposed
- [ ] Speculative

## Capability and safety impact

- [ ] No capability increase
- [ ] Consequential capability or data impact
- [ ] High-risk autonomy, actuation, credential, self-modification, physical, or irreversible impact

## Governance checks

- [ ] Trust does not create authority.
- [ ] Consent remains scoped and revocable.
- [ ] Consequential actions remain default-deny.
- [ ] Audit and independent stop controls remain effective.
- [ ] Threat model, tests, safety case, and rollback are updated.
